newsitem.title: USA: American General buys Calif. Holiday Inn.
newsitem.headline: American General buys Calif. Holiday Inn.

text.p: American General Hospitality Corp, a hotel real estate investment trust, said on Wednesday it has purchased a 204-room full-service Holiday Inn Resort in Monterey, Calif., for $12.6 million.
American General plans a $4 million renovation to the hotel and will convert the property into a Hilton hotel, American General said.

"The hotel is in need of physical improvements and the Holiday Inn affiliation was not adding significant value in this market, which makes the hotel an excellent candidate for our renovation and repositioning strategy," Steve Jorns, chief executive officer, said in a statement.
Jorns said the hotel's location is "excellent."

The company said it believes its strategy to renovate and rebrand this property will make it a more aggressive competitor in its market where occupancies are at 80 percent and the average room rate exceeds $120 a night.
